key_points: Q4 FY2026 earnings beat estimates; stock rose ~2.9% after release.
Fifth consecutive earnings beat and high membership renewal rate underscore strong fundamentals.
EVP Claudine Adamo sold 2,200 shares, a relatively small insider transaction.
Stock dipped 1.5% on the same day, reflecting broader market pressure rather than company-specific news.
Valuation remains elevated (~46x earnings); investors watching membership trends for future growth.
